content: Hilcías-machi-Jeremías we-gayaburbamar sogsad. Jeremíasʼde dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-gwenadgansik danikidid, Anatot-neggweburginedid. Anatot-neggweburde, Benjamín-yalagi siid.
Deunni, Amón-machi-Josías reyga birgambe-gakapaagus (13) Judá-yargi-maidgi, Jeremíasʼse Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nonikid.

Deginbali, Josías-machi-Joacim Judáʼgi reyga-maigusadgi, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba Jeremíasʼse nonigusbalid. Josías-machi-Sedequías Judáʼgi birgambe-gakagwensak-gaka-nii-walataledgi reyga-maid-bergusadse, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba Jeremíasʼse nonigusbalid. Wegisundo, a-ibagangi, deunni, Jerusalén-dulemar Babilonia-neggweburse gales-selesgusmalad.
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba anse nonikid, weyob anga nonikid:

content.text: “Jeremías, amba yoo be sapibeneggi-mege bato an be-susad.
Amba yoo be gwalulege, bato angadga an be-imaksad.
An wissulid, igi an dulemar-abargi sunmakoe.”
Ar bia an be-barmidoe, aba be naoed.
An bega-ibmarmar-sogoedi, bela dulemarga be sogmogoed.
Ani an be-bendakega beba gudii guoed.”

content: Geb agine, Bab-Jehová e-argan anse-oyoalid, geb an-gakuli ebusad. Agine weyob anga sogded: “Be-gwabindukugi an bega, an-gayaburbamargi-sunmakoed an nasiksad.
Emi-ibagi, yarmar-selemamaidgi, degi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi gargangued-nika an be-imaked:
Geb Bab-Jehová anga soged: “Jeremías, we-ibmar, ¿ibu-ibmar be dake?” Bab-Jehová-abin an sogded: “We an dakedi, sapi-almendro-ana an daked.”
Degi, Bab-Jehová anga sogded: “Nabir-be-soge, inniki be daksad. An-ibmar-sogsadi, sogedba-guega an imakedsegad.”

Geb Bab-Jehová gannar anga sognonibalid. Weyob anga sogded: “¿Jeremías, we-ibmar, ibu-ibmar be dakbali?” Bab-Jehová-abin an sogded: “We an dakedi, bormogi-dii-gwakwarmaknai an daked. A-dii-gwakwarmaknaid dad-nakwed-sapiled-akar aryodani an daked.”
Geb Bab-Jehová anga odaloded: “Dad-nakwed-sapiled-akale, bela we-yalagi-dulemar-bukwadgi, boni-dummagan an barmidoed.”
”Jeremías, bedi guakwagudii sao. An bega bela-ibmar-sogoedi, be sognao. Melle be we-dulemar dobguo. Degisulile, ani an dulemar-asabin-gwayega an be-imakoed.

Emi-ibagi, neggwebur-gandikidyob an be-imaksad. Bubawar-esgorobiidyob, an be-imaksad, degi, galu-matusulid-esgoro-gordikidbiidyob, an be-imaksad. An be-ogannosadi, bela we-yalagi dulemar-bukwadgi-yolegega an be-imaksad. Judá-e-reymargi-gwichiguega an be-imaksad, e-dummagangi-gwisguega an be-imaksad. Degine, e-dule-irwa-anse-gormaladgi-gwisguega an be-imaksad. Bela dulemar-e-neggweburginmaladgi-yolegega an be-ogannosad.
We-dulemar bela begi gwisgunanai gumaloed, degi-inigwele, begi obinosurmalad. Ar ani an, be-bendakega beba gudii guoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedgi, we-ibmar an bega soged.”
